question: With authentic rewarded UnlockPickup demonstrations and identical navigation scaffolds, can a tokenless causal memory system learn and compose observed key acquisition -> door toggle -> rewarded box-pickup consequences and improve heldout physical goal reward beyond matched sham and trained conventional controls?
hypothesis: After genuine shared physical reward-bearing training, the bounded learned causal graph earns at least 8/12 official goals in heldout UnlockPickup seeds, beats a capacity- and scaffold-matched shuffled-edge sham by >=0.06 mean official discounted reward and >=7/12 strict per-seed wins, and beats the strongest trained conventional Q/recurrent comparator by >=0.03 mean discounted reward, without degrading heldout DoorKey-8x8 performance or post-interference cold retention. Failure is reported without retuning.

predecessor_evidence.reason: All five controllers scored 0/12 official goals on heldout UnlockPickup; 48 rewarded DoorKey training episodes did not create actual box-pickup teacher coverage.
Fully trained reward policies beat map policy on discounted return in at least one transfer setting.

prior_data_exclusion: No reuse of MD22 registered 930001..970012 seeds, MG21 registered cohorts, or prior original first-use outcomes as prospective evidence. Prior negative results remain frozen.

immutable_dependencies.third_party: Python 3.12; minigrid==3.2.0; gymnasium==1.4.0; numpy==2.3.4; package lock and pip freeze identity required in artifacts
immutable_dependencies.license: MiniGrid MIT; no external data, credentials, paid APIs or pretrained weights

frozen_design.cold_before_and_after: MiniGrid-DoorKey-6x6-v0 seeds 983001..983012 (12 per arm each occasion)
frozen_design.no_zero_shot_family_claim: UnlockPickup is INCLUDED in training; heldout UnlockPickup tests new episodes/layouts of a trained task family, not novel-family zero-shot transfer.
frozen_design.common_training: Exactly one public 7x7x3 image+public direction+charged action/reward trajectory per training episode from a freshly reset scripted teacher. Each of six arms gets the SAME exact 48 physical demonstrations and 12 interference episodes. No hidden grid/global pose/env.agent_pos/object positions, oracle information, future reward, mission string, or environment-specific access at inference.
frozen_design.teacher: Fixed public-observation-only mapping/frontier search, object acquisition, locked-door interaction and rewarded terminal box pickup; may exploit ONLY image, direction, observed reward, own action history. The teacher's navigation/subgoal procedure is explicitly scripted, not learned. It is evaluated for reward-coverage on disjoint toy seeds before registered first use.
frozen_design.learner: A bounded, tokenless event-graph of conditional observed effects: key pickup changes carry state, physical toggle before/after key changes door state, rewarded box pickup terminates task. Online counts are updated only from the shared charged training trajectory; at test time graph selects subgoals using observed conditional edges and recomposes them under a fixed public-view navigator. No pretrained language model or next-token learning.
frozen_design.sham: Identical map/nav procedure, checkpoint capacity, training counts and training data, but deterministic permutation of conditional edges at subgoal-selection time. No hidden reward or use of heldout outcomes.
frozen_design.fixed_scripted: Frozen equal-sensor public-view hand-scripted key -> door -> box-or-goal planner with no learning; included as an important ceiling/control, with no claim of superiority to this expert.
frozen_design.conventional: Original fully trainable reward-tabular-Q and 12-hidden recurrent imitation with all trainable input, recurrent, bias and readout parameters and positive-reward shared trajectory updates; include original reactive policy. Training/steps/information matched. Existing baseline algorithms and hyperparameters remain frozen.
frozen_design.accounting: 48 teacher train + 12 teacher interference + 4 evaluation phases x 12 seeds x 6 policies = 348 episodes. Training shared once, evaluation independent actual env.step for each arm. No simulated/oracle paid action.
frozen_design.evaluation_freeze: Full policy/checkpoint snapshot before each heldout suite. Heldout physical observations may update only within-episode map/pose, never the learned persistent graph/Q/recurrent weights. Serialized snapshots must be byte-identical afterward; checksum every action trajectory.
frozen_design.cross_platform: Run first use once per OS only from frozen source SHA/branch and new draft PR opened event after prefirstuse tests. Full inherited regression and source-aligned G29 atlas on Ubuntu/Windows, strict same non-timing action/reward/checkpoint hashes, CPU recorded separately.
frozen_design.source_and_result_custody: Prereg commit must precede learner source, any registered seed execution, and result. Registered first-use one-shot and never replayed on postresult commits. Original full receipts stored only in GitHub Actions, not ChatGPT Library.
frozen_design.accuracy_scope: Claim narrow, reward-bearing within-task causal-composition DEV mechanism only; not native Yggdrasil, novel-family zero-shot transfer, fully learned exploration, AGI or scientific acceptance.

primary.compared_to_fixed_scripted: Report goal counts, reward gaps and steps in both families. No requirement to beat scripted ceiling, no superiority-to-scripted claim.

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY if and only if all validity, reproducibility, and primary gates hold. Remains external DEV; separate independent scientific acceptance still required.
classification_rules.mixed: MIXED_DEV only if all coverage and custody gates hold but primary fails and causal_graph reaches >=8/12 goals on heldout box OR beats shuffled_graph in mean discounted reward by >=0.03 on heldout box.
classification_rules.negative: NEGATIVE_DEV if all coverage/custody gates hold, primary false, and mixed predicate false.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID_TASK_COVERAGE for failed teacher/intervention/heldout positive-reward coverage. INVALID_REPRO/INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE for source or dependency drift, hidden-data access, action-budget breach, seed reuse/firstuse replay, missing full regression, Q/RNN not actually trained, corrupt checkpoint, unequal shared training, after-result tuning or non-timing crossOS parity mismatch. Valid unfavorable reward is never infrastructure failure.

prohibited_after_primary_run: Changing teacher/nav policy, learner, controls, scores or thresholds using registered results
Expanding capacity/data/compute or adding privileged observations
Treating a scripted planner or task-trained familiarity as learned general intelligence
preregistration_note: This commit is protocol-only: no registered environment execution, primary evidence, source implementation, workflow dispatch, integration, or model improvement is claimed.
